title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.3 (Peaked October 06, 2026 at 21:36 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 384 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G2 Predicted

I'm still watching that earlier M1.8 flare. ✨

Solar imagery shows a few small sunspot groups, modest bright active regions, and a broad dark coronal feature, with no obvious large outward structure visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
